_comment: Editable OS support lifecycle table used to flag end-of-support systems. Dates are for Home/Pro editions (Windows) and Apple's usual N-2 policy (macOS).

windows_builds.name: Windows 10 or older
windows_builds.note: Windows 10 reached end of support on 14 Oct 2025 (security updates only via paid ESU).

macos_note: Apple generally provides full security updates only for the current macOS and the two previous major releases.
